_doc: Cadence profiles shared by EVERY style. A style pack names one in style.json ("cadence"). shot_len = seconds a framing stays before the next picture (seconds); events_per_min = camera events (moves + cuts) when the style drives the camera with beats; max_hold = longest time with no camera event; aspect notes the frame the profile was measured on.

beat-short.use: vertical Shorts with a beat-driven 3D camera (inkbeat)
beat-short.motion: never still: drift 3 percent per second, a move about every second, push-through cuts

cutaway-short.motion: a cut every 2-4 s (wide establishing then close detail), a punch-in zoom on each key beat, a macro push into the cutaway
forbid: handheld shake except on an impact

kids-song.motion: gentle: slow pushes and slides, cuts land on the beat of the music, camera at toddler eye height

film-cinematic.use: narrative or documentary long-form with motivated moves (anime-cinematic, pixar-soft, noir)
film-cinematic.motion: mostly held frames; a slow push, slide or pan only for a reason that can be said in one sentence; parallax over zoom

longform-calm.use: calm explainers and talking heads, 16:9 or 9:16
longform-calm.motion: classic coverage (master, medium, close, reverse), keep the 180 degree line, a slow push on about 1 shot in 3
forbid: burned-in captions on long-form (ship an SRT)

explainer-2d.use: 2D card and diagram explainers (editorial, notebook, voxel, stickman packs)
explainer-2d.motion: a new picture or a visible change every 1.5-3.5 s; slow push on 3D shots
